verdict.rationale: Glama Chat lets users upload their own documents and get AI-generated answers with page references, compare model outputs, and turn text into diagrams — a form of AI-generated insight from user data (glama-docs-18, glama-docs-17, glama-docs-19). Separately, the TDQS quality-scoring system auto-generates insights/suggestions about a user's own MCP server listings (glama-comm-1), though community reports show the scoring pipeline was unreliable and undocumented (glama-comm-2, glama-comm-3). Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions/insights generated from a user's operational MCP usage data (e.g., analytics on tool calls, gateway traffic) rather than just chat-uploaded documents, and independent corroboration that chat insight features work reliably.
